m: साशीर्क mfn. containing a prayer or blessing, TS. (a more correct form would be साशीष्क, but cf. अन्-आशीर्क).
साशीति mfn. with eighty, increased by eighty, plus eighty, Yājñ.
साशूक m. a blanket (= कम्बल), L.

a: साशंक — a. Feeling fear, apprehensive, afraid, dismayed.

m: साशंस mfn. having desire, desirous, hopeful (अम् ind. ‘wishfully’, ‘hopefully’), Mṛcch.; Kālid.; Kir.
a: साशंस — a. Full of desire or passion, desirous, hopeful, expectant. --सं ind. Wishfully, hopefully.

m: साशंसम् (अम्), ind., ‘wishfully’, ‘hopefully’
साशङ्क mf(आ)n. having fear or anxiety, apprehensive, afraid of (loc.; अम् ind. ‘apprehensively’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
साशङ्कम् (अम्), ind., ‘apprehensively’
साशङ्क—ता f. the state of being afraid or apprehensive, fear, terror, MW.
साशनानशन n. du. having and not having food, that which eats and does not eat, earthly and heavenly beings, RV.
साशनार m. N. of a partic. Agrahāra or royal grant to Brāhmans, MW.
साशन mfn. having food (see next).
साशयन्दक (?) m. a small house-lizard (= ज्येष्ठी), L.
साश्चर्य mfn. astonished, surprised by (comp.), Kathās.
wonderful, marvellous, astonishing, Bhartṛ.
a: साश्चर्य — a. 1 Wonderful, marvellous. --2 Struck with wonder. --र्यं ind. With wonder or astonishment.

m: साश्चर्य—चर्य mfn. of wonderful conduct, Bhartṛ.; Rājat.
साश्चर्य—कौतुक mfn. astonished and curious, Kathās.
साश्चर्यम् ind. with astonishment or surprise, Hit.
साश्चर्य—मय mf(ई)n. wonderful, full of marvels, MW.
साशिक्य N. of a people or country (cf. शाशिक), Daś.
साशिर mfn. (fr. 7. स + आशिर = आशिर्) with admixture, mixed, TS.; ŚBr.
साश्म-वर्षिन् mfn. accompanied by a shower of stones, BhP.
1. साश्र mfn. (fr. 7. स + 1. अश्र) having angles or corners, angular, MW.
2. साश्र mfn. (fr. 7. स + 2. अश्र; more correctly written सास्र) tearful, weeping, KāśīKh.
a: साश्र(स्र) — a. 1 Having angles or corners, angular. --2 Tearful, weeping.

m: साश्रु mfn. accompanied by tears, tearful, shedding tears (˚उ ind.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
साश्रु (उ), ind.
a: साश्रु — a. Tearful, full of tears, shedding tears.

v: strI sASru DyAyati DyE--kvip sampra॰ । SvaSrvAm trikA
m: साश्रु—धी f. ‘having a sad heart’, a mother-in-law, L.
a: साश्रुधी — A wife's or husband's mother, a mother-in-law.

m: साश्रु—नयन or साश्रु—लोचन, mfn. having tearful eyes, MBh.
साश्व mfn. with horses, possessing horses, KātyŚr.
N. of a king, MBh.
साश्व-मेध mfn. together with a horse-sacrifice, Vait.
